items.html: This clothing is called inclusion, and wherever below you find the matter of inclusion, it means that this one clothes that one — understand this matter well. Now, the Yesod of Atik has no ascent, for it ends at the chest of Arich, as mentioned. And afterward, in this order, Arich Anpin too gathered in his exposed NHY, as mentioned, and raised them up into his HGT.
